name: Newsletter Postcard
description: A sign-up form on the back of a postcard: the email goes on the address lines, a postmark cancels the stamp and the card slides away as if posted.

props.name: title
props.description: The pitch at the top of the message side, set in the display face.

props.name: signature
props.description: A sign-off at the foot of the message.

props.name: onSubmit
props.description: Called with a valid address. While a returned promise is pending the button shows a spinner; when it resolves, the postmark draws across the stamp, the card slides away and a confirmation takes its place and receives focus. If it rejects, the card stays and an error shows under the address.

props.name: emailLabel
props.description: Visible label of the email field on the first address line.

props.name: stamp
props.description: Image for the stamp. Without it the stamp shows a small drawn landscape in the theme's colours.

props.name: stampAlt
props.description: Alternative text for the stamp image.

props.name: stampValue
props.description: The face value printed in the stamp's corner.

props.name: postmark
props.description: Place name around the postmark. The date is the day of posting.

props.name: imprint
props.description: Tiny printer's line set vertically along the divider, from 576px wide.

props.name: confirmation
props.description: Replaces the line under the confirmation heading.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root. Other div props are passed through.
